g.text: Smart LMS - Full product class diagram
UNIQUE(userId, role). Role assignment is authorized server-side.
Profiles store optional personal fields, not authorization.
grantedScopes restricts delegated administration; role alone is insufficient.
Prevent disabling/removing the last active administrator.
Admin scope does not automatically grant access to private content.
Course is the course/class permission boundary used in SRS.
No separate Classroom/cohort is defined in the current requirements.
Course teacherId must identify an authorized teacher.
Visibility/accessType/price live here only; no duplicate Course price.
FREE implies price = 0; PAID implies price > 0.
W2: teacher grants enrollment; self-join/payment come later.
Join code/password are hashed; never sent in public course metadata.
UNIQUE(userId, courseId). Revoke does not delete scores/submissions.
Authorize every request against current status and course scope.
Course progress is derived from eligible lesson completions.
New material defaults to PROTECTED: watermarked view, no clean download.
PUBLIC_DOWNLOAD: clean view/download for users already allowed to read.
This does not make the course public or grant enrollment.
A policy change increments policyRevision and invalidates cached access.
activeVersionId must refer to a READY version of this document.
UNIQUE(documentId, versionNumber). Original file remains private.
OCR/RAG reads the clean original, never the watermarked derivative.
Watermark failure must not fall back to a clean protected view.
W2 accepts text PDFs; other declared formats are for the final product.
W2: EXTRACTED != READY; indexedAt remains null until W3 indexing.
Activate a version for AI only after required extraction/index/view checks.
Old version stays active until replacement is ready; removed source is blocked.
Idempotency prevents duplicate extraction/chunks on retry.
Late workers cannot reactivate removed documents/versions.
A successful EXTRACT job alone does not mean RAG is ready.
UNIQUE(lessonId, documentId); both must belong to the same course.
Materials may be course-level without being linked to a lesson.
Scope: course default OR one quiz/assignment version in that course.
At most one active policy per scope; assessment overrides course default.
Private answer keys/rubrics are excluded from the learning corpus.
Missing policy/context never enables unrestricted answer disclosure.
Exactly one owner: quizVersionId XOR checkpointId.
MVP/final agreed assessment uses single-choice questions.
Draft can have no options; published question needs >= 2 options
and exactly one correct option. Essay belongs to Assignment.
UNIQUE(userId, quizId): one attempt across versions.
quizVersion must belong to quiz; freeze used/published attempt version.
expiresAt = min(startedAt + durationSeconds, dueAt), server time.
Expiry finalization is idempotent; EXPIRED is a scored final state.
NULL score means not graded, never silently replaced with zero.
Question belongs to the attempt's QuizVersion;
selected option must belong to that question (null = unanswered).
Never expose isCorrect/answer keys before permitted publication.
UNIQUE(userId, assignmentId). Used version is immutable.
Text XOR one file; PDF/PNG/JPEG <= 20 MiB in the agreed MVP.
No late submission/resubmission in the current agreed rules.
Manual grade: 0 <= score <= 10; publishedAt controls student visibility.
Record grader and audit any change to a published grade.
UNIQUE(userId, lessonId). No video is required for a text/PDF lesson.
Quiz/assignment lessonId is optional; if set, same course as assessment.
At a checkpoint: pause. Correct -> pass and continue.
Wrong -> REWATCH_REQUIRED: watch the configured segment, then retry.
Server validates order/progress; seeking/reloading cannot bypass a gate.
Attempt option must belong to this checkpoint's question.
Progress video version must equal checkpoint video version.
Media access is authorized; progress persists after reload/restart.
A version with recorded activity is immutable; changes create a new version.
No automatic completion from client playback position alone.
Multiple retry transactions may exist; settle one order exactly once.
Verify signature, order, currency and expected amount server-side.
Redirect success/client data never grants paid access.
Order total = sum of server-side price snapshots; use Decimal.
sellerId freezes the payee for historical revenue even if ownership changes.
PURCHASE requires verified payment and matching user/course order item.
Refund revokes the corresponding grant; other valid grants remain.
Enrollment is ACTIVE only while at least one eligible grant is valid.
W2 can store manual status first; migrate to grant tracking for payments.
OrderItem must belong to the payment's order.
Confirmed refunds cannot exceed the settled item/transaction amount.
UNIQUE(provider, providerRefundId) when non-null; provider matches payment.
Full item refund revokes its purchase grant; partial refund follows policy.
Preserve historical grades/submissions. Revenue = settled minus confirmed refunds.
Derive courseId/documentId through DocumentVersion; never mix scopes.
Vector metadata includes courseId, documentId, versionId, chunkId.
ANN/BM25 indexes are rebuildable derived data, not the authority for access.
Bind to the exact document version, not mutable current document alone.
PDF: physical page 1-based; PPTX: real slide 1-based;
DOCX: section/paragraph ID; TXT: paragraph or line interval.
chunkId optional for summaries; if set, same cited document version.
Offsets bind a citation to a span of the assistant answer.
A citation never bypasses course/material policy; removed sources are blocked.
retrievalScore is not a calibrated probability of answer correctness.
Only ASSISTANT messages have AIResponse; empty conversations are valid.
Recheck course membership, source version and assistant policy before return.
GENERAL is an explicit QA choice; never implicit fallback for missing sources.
Message assessment/source context must match the conversation course/user.
SUMMARY documentVersionId and sourceScope define the actual source range.
Policy ID/revision identify the course/assessment policy used for the hint.
Config/model/adapter versions are immutable for reproducible traces.
Adapter must match the selected base model.
Offline comparison, no trafficPercent or student A/B routing.
BASE_LLM: no adapter, no RAG config.
RAG: no adapter, RAG config required.
QLORA_RAG: matching adapter and RAG config required.
Keep split, model/prompt/config and per-sample results for fair evaluation.
Convert relations into FKs, UNIQUE and CHECK constraints in the ERD/migrations.
Cross-entity rules require transactional service checks as well as FKs.
Dashboard/revenue/course progress are queries, not duplicate stored totals.
Blue / «W2»: prioritize in W2; not evidence of implementation.
FK labels identify foreign keys; nullable relations use 0..1.
PK = id: UUID. Money = Decimal, never Float.
State fields are closed values listed in notes, not arbitrary strings.
Relations do not prescribe ON DELETE CASCADE.
